verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rule engine that fires actions on events. Several items come close but don't qualify. Configurable risk-score equations and screening/monitoring configurations are adjacent settings. The agentic auto-remediation and auto-escalation of alerts are vendor-defined behaviours, not user-authored rules. Outbound webhooks such as WORKFLOW_COMPLETED are building blocks for automation the user would build elsewhere. The Starter plan's configuration also 'cannot be customized'.
